from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from os import getenv

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from backend.app.application.announcement.announcement_composer import (
    AnnouncementComposer,
)
from backend.app.application.announcement.announcement_publisher import (
    ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
    PublicationDisabledError,
)
from backend.app.application.announcement.models import AnnouncementType


class AnnouncementPublishRequest(BaseModel):
    """Administrator request for publishing a Beta announcement."""

    announcement_type: AnnouncementType
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    body: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=1800)
    footer: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=300)


class AnnouncementPublishResponse(BaseModel):
    """Controlled publication result."""

    channel_id: str
    message_id: str
    announcement_type: str
    published_at: str


AdminAuthorizer = Callable[[], Awaitable[bool]]


async def _default_admin_authorizer() -> bool:
    """
    Fail-closed default administrator authorization.

    Production composition must inject the real administrator
    authorization mechanism.
    """
    return False


def create_announcement_router(
    *,
    publisher: ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
    composer: AnnouncementComposer | None = None,
    admin_authorizer: AdminAuthorizer = _default_admin_authorizer,
) -> APIRouter:
    """
    Create the WS-02 administrator announcement router.

    The API layer does not:
    - talk directly to Telegram;
    - construct Telegram clients;
    - bypass AnnouncementPolicy;
    - bypass ControlledAnnouncementPublisher;
    - perform autonomous publication.
    """

    if publisher is None:
        raise ValueError("publisher cannot be None.")

    if admin_authorizer is None:
        raise ValueError("admin_authorizer cannot be None.")

    announcement_composer = composer or AnnouncementComposer()

    router = APIRouter(
        prefix="/admin/announcements",
        tags=["admin-announcements"],
    )

    async def require_admin() -> None:
        try:
            authorized = await admin_authorizer()
        except Exception:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="Administrator authorization required.",
            ) from None

        if not authorized:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="Administrator authorization required.",
            )

    @router.post(
        "/publish",
        response_model=AnnouncementPublishResponse,
        status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
        dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)],
    )
    async def publish_announcement(
        request: AnnouncementPublishRequest,
    ) -> AnnouncementPublishResponse:
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Composition / policy validation
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        try:
            composed = announcement_composer.compose(
                announcement_type=request.announcement_type,
                title=request.title,
                body=request.body,
                footer=request.footer,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Configuration
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        try:
            channel_id = _resolve_channel_id()
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Controlled publication
        #
        # PublicationDisabledError is an expected operational state.
        # It is translated here at the HTTP boundary into 503.
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        try:
            record = await publisher.publish(
                channel_id=channel_id,
                text=composed.rendered_text,
                announcement_type=(
                    composed.announcement.announcement_type.value
                ),
            )
        except PublicationDisabledError:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                detail="Telegram announcement publishing is disabled.",
            ) from None
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Successful publication
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        return AnnouncementPublishResponse(
            channel_id=record.channel_id,
            message_id=record.message_id,
            announcement_type=record.announcement_type,
            published_at=record.published_at.isoformat(),
        )

    return router


def _resolve_channel_id() -> str:
    """
    Resolve the Beta 1 announcement channel from configuration.

    The channel ID is deliberately not hard-coded.
    """

    channel_id = getenv(
        "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID",
    )

    if not channel_id:
        raise ValueError(
            "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID is not configured."
        )

    return channel_id


__all__ = [
    "AnnouncementPublishRequest",
    "AnnouncementPublishResponse",
    "create_announcement_router",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Protocol


class AnnouncementPublisher(Protocol):
    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        channel_id: str,
        text: str,
    ) -> str:
        """Publish an announcement and return its external message ID."""


class PublicationDisabledError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when controlled announcement publishing is disabled."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicationRecord:
    channel_id: str
    message_id: str
    announcement_type: str
    published_at: datetime


class ControlledAnnouncementPublisher:
    """Application boundary enforcing the explicit Beta 1 publication switch."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        publisher: AnnouncementPublisher,
        publishing_enabled: bool,
    ) -> None:
        if publisher is None:
            raise ValueError("publisher cannot be None.")

        self._publisher = publisher
        self._publishing_enabled = publishing_enabled

    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        channel_id: str,
        text: str,
        announcement_type: str,
    ) -> PublicationRecord:
        if not self._publishing_enabled:
            raise PublicationDisabledError(
                "Telegram announcement publishing is disabled."
            )

        message_id = await self._publisher.publish(
            channel_id=channel_id,
            text=text,
        )

        return PublicationRecord(
            channel_id=channel_id,
            message_id=message_id,
            announcement_type=announcement_type,
            published_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from .announcement_policy import AnnouncementPolicy
from .models import Announcement, AnnouncementType, ComposedAnnouncement


_TYPE_LABELS: dict[AnnouncementType, str] = {
    AnnouncementType.NEW_FEATURE: "ðŸš€ NEW FEATURE",
    AnnouncementType.MAINTENANCE: "ðŸ› ï¸ MAINTENANCE",
    AnnouncementType.KNOWN_ISSUE: "ðŸ› KNOWN ISSUE",
    AnnouncementType.INCIDENT: "ðŸš¨ INCIDENT",
    AnnouncementType.PLANNED_DOWNTIME: "ðŸ• PLANNED DOWNTIME",
    AnnouncementType.IMPORTANT: "ðŸ“¢ IMPORTANT",
    AnnouncementType.BETA_TEST: "ðŸ§ª BETA TEST",
    AnnouncementType.FEEDBACK: "ðŸ’¬ FEEDBACK",
    AnnouncementType.PRIVACY: "ðŸ” PRIVACY",
    AnnouncementType.POLICY: "ðŸ“œ POLICY",
    AnnouncementType.BETA_UPDATE: "ðŸŽ“ BETA UPDATE",
    AnnouncementType.OTHER: "ðŸ“Œ UPDATE",
}


class AnnouncementComposer:
    """Creates validated, consistent EasyWorld announcement messages."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        policy: AnnouncementPolicy | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._policy = policy or AnnouncementPolicy()

    def compose(
        self,
        *,
        announcement_type: AnnouncementType,
        title: str,
        body: str,
        footer: str | None = None,
    ) -> ComposedAnnouncement:
        announcement = Announcement(
            announcement_type=announcement_type,
            title=title,
            body=body,
            footer=footer,
        )

        self._policy.validate(announcement)

        parts = [
            _TYPE_LABELS[announcement_type],
            "",
            f"**{announcement.title.strip()}**",
            "",
            announcement.body.strip(),
        ]

        if announcement.footer:
            parts.extend(["", announcement.footer.strip()])

        parts.extend(["", "ðŸŒ± *EasyWorld â€” Growing with You*"])

        return ComposedAnnouncement(
            announcement=announcement,
            rendered_text="\n".join(parts),
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Any

from telegram import Bot


class TelegramAnnouncementClient:
    """
    Outbound-only Telegram client for controlled announcements.

    Responsibilities:
    - authenticate using TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN;
    - send outbound announcement messages;
    - provide controlled Telegram transport.

    This client MUST NOT:
    - start Telegram polling;
    - register Telegram handlers;
    - execute classroom conversations;
    - perform authorization;
    - bypass ControlledAnnouncementPublisher.

    The classroom Telegram runtime owns inbound update polling.
    This client is strictly outbound.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        token: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        resolved_token = (
            token
            or os.getenv("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN")
        )

        if not resolved_token:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is missing."
            )

        self._bot = Bot(
            token=resolved_token,
        )

    async def send_message(
        self,
        *,
        chat_id: str,
        text: str,
    ) -> Any:
        """
        Send one outbound Telegram announcement.

        This operation does not start polling and does not
        interact with the inbound Telegram update lifecycle.
        """

        return await self._bot.send_message(
            chat_id=chat_id,
            text=text,
        )

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """
        Release the underlying Telegram client resources.
        """

        await self._bot.shutdown()


__all__ = [
    "TelegramAnnouncementClient",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


class TelegramAnnouncementPublisher:
    """Thin infrastructure adapter for the Telegram announcement channel."""

    def __init__(self, *, telegram_client: Any) -> None:
        if telegram_client is None:
            raise ValueError("telegram_client cannot be None.")

        self._telegram_client = telegram_client

    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        channel_id: str,
        text: str,
    ) -> str:
        if not channel_id.strip():
            raise ValueError("channel_id is required.")

        if not text.strip():
            raise ValueError("text is required.")

        result = await self._telegram_client.send_message(
            chat_id=channel_id,
            text=text,
            parse_mode="Markdown",
        )

        message_id = getattr(result, "message_id", None)
        if message_id is None:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Telegram publisher did not receive a message identifier."
            )

        return str(message_id)

#
# Scheduler runtime instance
#

scheduler_runtime = create_cybersecurity_scheduler_runtime()


#
# Announcement configuration
#

def _announcement_publishing_enabled() -> bool:
    """
    Resolve the explicit Beta 1 announcement publication switch.

    Publication is disabled by default.

    Accepted truthy values:
    - true
    - 1
    - yes
    - on
    """

    value = os.getenv(
        "EASYCHATBOT_ANNOUNCEMENT_PUBLISHING_ENABLED",
        "false",
    )

    return value.strip().lower() in {
        "true",
        "1",
        "yes",
        "on",
    }


#
# Administrator authorization
#

async def _default_announcement_admin_authorizer() -> bool:
    """
    Fail-closed administrator authorization.

    The repository does not yet expose a real authenticated
    operator identity dependency.

    Therefore announcement publication MUST remain denied
    until the real authentication/authorization boundary is
    connected.

    This is intentional security behavior.
    """

    return False


#
# Announcement composition
#

def _create_announcement_components() -> tuple[
    TelegramAnnouncementClient,
    ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
]:
    """
    Compose the outbound announcement publication infrastructure.

    This function creates an outbound-only Telegram client.

    It does NOT:
    - start Telegram polling;
    - create Telegram handlers;
    - create the classroom Telegram runtime;
    - call getUpdates();
    """

    telegram_client = TelegramAnnouncementClient()

    telegram_publisher = TelegramAnnouncementPublisher(
        telegram_client=telegram_client,
    )

    controlled_publisher = ControlledAnnouncementPublisher(
        publisher=telegram_publisher,
        publishing_enabled=_announcement_publishing_enabled(),
    )

    return (
        telegram_client,
        controlled_publisher,
    )


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(
    application: FastAPI,
):
    """
    Application lifecycle.

    Starts:
    - cybersecurity scheduler runtime.

    Stops:
    - cybersecurity scheduler runtime;
    - outbound announcement Telegram client.

    IMPORTANT:

    The classroom Telegram polling runtime is NOT started here.

    It remains owned by:

        backend/scripts/run_telegram_runtime.py

    This prevents multiple getUpdates consumers.
    """

    try:
        await scheduler_runtime.start()

    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception(
            "Cybersecurity scheduler startup failed: %s",
            exc,
        )

    try:
        yield

    finally:

        #
        # Scheduler shutdown
        #

        try:
            await scheduler_runtime.stop()

        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception(
                "Cybersecurity scheduler shutdown failed: %s",
                exc,
            )

        #
        # Announcement Telegram client shutdown
        #
        # The client is outbound-only and does not own Telegram
        # polling.
        #

        telegram_client = getattr(
            application.state,
            "announcement_telegram_client",
            None,
        )

        if telegram_client is not None:

            try:
                await telegram_client.close()

            except Exception as exc:
                logger.exception(
                    "Announcement Telegram client shutdown failed: %s",
                    exc,
                )


def create_application() -> FastAPI:
    """
    Create and configure FastAPI application.
    """

    #
    # Announcement dependency composition.
    #
    # This creates only the outbound Telegram client.
    #
    # It does NOT start Telegram polling.
    #

    (
        announcement_telegram_client,
        announcement_publisher,
    ) = _create_announcement_components()

    application = FastAPI(
        title="EasyChatBot API",
        description="AI character learning platform API",
        version="0.1.0",
        lifespan=lifespan,
    )

    #
    # Store infrastructure resource on application state.
    #
    # Lifespan closes it during application shutdown.
    #

    application.state.announcement_telegram_client = (
        announcement_telegram_client
    )

    #
    # CORS
    #

    application.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=[
            "http://localhost:3000",
            "http://127.0.0.1:3000",
            "http://localhost:5173",
            "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
        ],
        allow_credentials=True,
        allow_methods=[
            "*",
        ],
        allow_headers=[
            "*",
        ],
    )

    #
    # Voice APIs
    #

    application.include_router(
        voice_calls_router,
    )

    application.include_router(
        voice_reconnect_router,
    )

    application.include_router(
        voice_call_trigger_router,
    )

    application.include_router(
        voice_notification_acceptance_router,
    )

    #
    # AI Operations Center
    #

    application.include_router(
        operations_center_router,
    )

    #
    # Privacy Governance Operations Center
    #
    # Existing privacy governance API contract.
    #

    application.include_router(
        privacy_governance_router,
    )

    #
    # Provider Management Controls
    #

    application.include_router(
        provider_management_controls_router,
    )

    #
    # Governance Audit API
    #

    application.include_router(
        governance_audit_router,
    )

    #
    # Operations Center Governance API
    #

    application.include_router(
        governance_operations_router,
    )

    #
    # Governance Evidence Timeline API
    #

    application.include_router(
        governance_evidence_router,
    )

    #
    # Governance Change Lifecycle API
    #

    application.include_router(
        governance_change_lifecycle_router,
    )

    #
    # Cybersecurity Intelligence
    #

    application.include_router(
        cybersecurity_intelligence_router,
    )

    #
    # Cybersecurity Decision Support
    #

    application.include_router(
        cybersecurity_decision_support_router,
    )

    #
    # Cybersecurity Reports
    #

    application.include_router(
        cybersecurity_reports_router,
    )

    #
    # Cybersecurity Live Reports
    #

    application.include_router(
        cybersecurity_live_reports_router,
    )

    #
    # Announcement Operations
    #
    # Controlled administrator publication boundary.
    #
    # Endpoint:
    #
    # POST /admin/announcements/publish
    #
    # Security:
    #
    # - administrator authorization required;
    # - authorization currently fails closed;
    # - publication switch independently controls execution;
    # - Telegram channel ID comes from configuration;
    # - Telegram transport is outbound-only.
    #

    application.include_router(
        create_announcement_router(
            publisher=announcement_publisher,
            admin_authorizer=(
                _default_announcement_admin_authorizer
            ),
        ),
    )

    return application


app = create_application()


__all__ = [
    "app",
    "create_application",
]
